ios.desc:
A brand-new bedtime story every night, starring your kid, read aloud by Pup or in your own voice.

ROLL A STORY
Roll the story dice for a hero, a place and a twist. Lock the ones you love, pick a feeling (cozy, silly, brave or sleepy) and a length, and Pup writes a story made just for your child. Or tell Pup your own idea.

READ BY PUP, OR BY YOU
Pup, our sleepy storytelling puppy, reads every story aloud. Bottle your own voice by reading a short script for about 10 seconds, and any story can be read in it, even when you are away from home.

A CALM BEDTIME PLAYER
Words light up as they are read, so early readers can follow along. Set a sleep timer, turn on Lights out for amber words on black, and when the story ends the screen fades to black on its own.

TONIGHT'S STACK
Line up a few stories and Pup reads them one after another, so a 20 minute sleep timer has plenty to read. Timed stops finish the sentence, then fade out gently.

YOUR CHILD'S SHELF
Every story lands on the shelf. Search it, keep favorites, and send a story to grandparents with a link they can listen to without the app.

MADE FOR YOUR KIDS
Tell Pup your child's name, age and favorite things, and stories are pitched for them. No ads, nothing flashing, nothing to tap inside the story.

FREE AND UNLIMITED
Free: 3 new stories a week, 3 stories on the shelf, and 1 voice of your own plus Pup's.
Unlimited: unlimited new stories, every story kept, and up to 10 voices. Billed through the App Store; cancel anytime in Settings.

Terms of service: https://storypup.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://storypup.com/privacy

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built StoryPup to make creating personalized stories for kids easier and more fun. It uses AI to help generate unique tales, and you can even use your own voice for narration to make them extra special.

Built this as a parent who wanted a better way to engage my kids with stories. Would love to hear your thoughts or any feedback!

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/storypup/id6744484541
